newsitem.title: FRANCE: France, Germany to help destroy Bosnia weapons.
newsitem.headline: France, Germany to help destroy Bosnia weapons.

text.p: France and Germany will provide blowlamp gas and operators to Serbia and Bosnia to destroy large quantities of weapons, the Paris defence ministry said on Monday.

It said Germany would provide army personnel and France would supply the gas needed to destroy 800 artillery pieces, 150 tanks and 20 armoured vehicles in Serbia and 700 heavy guns in the Bosnia-Herzegovina federation.
Forty percent of the weapons will be destroyed by July 14, with the rest following between September 15 and October 31.

NATO contributors to a NATO-led force in Bosnia fear that, unless peace accords are implemented in full, the Balkan country could slip back into war after foreign troops leave as scheduled in June 1998.
